huddle.notes: GameDay Huddle 1.2.0 — brings billing to the tablet. Buy your team's season term right from the Billing screen and it unlocks on the spot; a term bought early stacks onto the end of the current one. Forgot your password? Reset it from the sign-in screen with a code sent to your email. When a season ends, a fresh invite code takes you straight back to your team, and signing out now backs your work up to the cloud first — and says so plainly if it could not.
